tweets.text:
Launching our latest quarterly Artificial Analysis State of AI Report: Our analysis of the key trends shaping AI

A highlights version of the report is available for download on our website for a limited time.

We unpack 6 trends defining AI in early 2025:
1.⚡ The race for frontier AI continues: Top labs are releasing new models every 8–12 weeks; OpenAI still leads, but traditional challengers like Google and Anthropic have been joined just behind OpenAI by xAI, DeepSeek and Alibaba

2.💡 Reasoning models reach production: Models that 'think before answering' trade speed and cost for greater intelligence, using ~10x more tokens and costing ~10x more than non-reasoners

3. ⚙️ MoEs are everywhere: Mixture of Experts models activate just a small % of their total parameters for each token generated, most top open weights models are now MoEs

4. 🇨🇳 China’s top labs nearly close the gap: DeepSeek, Alibaba, Tencent, StepFun, Bytedance, Kuaishou and others are releasing highly competitive models - and often releasing the weights

5. 🤖 Agents go to work: LLM-driven systems that act autonomously and use tools to complete tasks end-to-end are beginning to get real work done. Key agents emerging as product categories include coding agents, Deep Research and computer use

6. 🎥 LLMs become natively multimodal: LLMs are now outputting more than text. GPT-4o is now the leader in image generation and Speech to Speech models have been released

We are releasing a highlights version of the report free on our website for a limited time.
